values.value: Controller Avatar Animations v0.2 Instructions: - Place the animations in your vnyan > items > animations folder - In Vnyan Settings > misc, scroll to the bottom and turn on capture gamepad. Restart the program - Set the Grey "Camera 1" node to whatever your default stream camera is - Set the Grey "Camera 12" node to a camera centered and zoomed out enough to capture your full character - [OPTIONAL] You can modify what animations play when you press specified buttons, see below Right click on the Cyan Websocket or Hotkey node and send signal to start! To stop the effect, right click the cyan Websocket or Hotkey Node and send signal again. Optional: - Tweak thumbstick movement affects by adjusting the operation values in the red/blue parameter operation nodes below! By default, the left thumbstick triggers the walking animation and the right thumbstick rotates your character. - Set the Green "Y" button filters to whatever (it plays the Green "Cartwheel" animation node by default) - Set the Yellow "Right Shoulder" button filters to whatever (it plays the Yellow "Saluting" animation node by default) - Set the Cyan " Right Trigger" button filters to whatever (it plays the Cyan "Boxing" animation node by default) - Set the Black "B" button filters to whatever (it plays the Black "Sitting on Ground" animation node by default) - Set the Grey "Left Stick" button filters to whatever (it plays the Grey "Running" animation node by default) - The other Grey "Jogging" animation node controls your walking animation when no other button is pressed - The Pink "Idle" animation node controls your idle animation
